top_5_failure_modes.real_example: @AmazonHelp my package was delivered 4 days late and when I opened it the teapot was completely shattered! I want a full refund and an exchange.
top_5_failure_modes.actual_result: Intent: refund_cancellation | Action: AUTO_HANDLE refund instructions
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: Sentence embeddings averaged the delivery delay, broken product, and refund request; single-label classifier picked refund.
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Customer mentions both broken physical item and monetary refund; refund tokens dominated TF-IDF features.
top_5_failure_modes.recommended_fix: Implement hierarchical multi-label intent parser or prioritize physical item damage over generic refund phrasing.

top_5_failure_modes.expected_result: Action: ASK_CLARIFYING_QUESTION ('Could you provide order number?')
top_5_failure_modes.actual_result: Intent: order_delay_tracking (Conf: 0.38) -> Escalated or generic tracking reply
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: Ultra-short 1-2 word messages lack lexical features to differentiate tracking inquiry from return delay.
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Word count threshold must explicitly trigger CLARIFY before passing to retrieval.
top_5_failure_modes.recommended_fix: Enforce strict length gate: messages with < 3 tokens immediately trigger clarification prompt.

top_5_failure_modes.category: False Escalation on Standard Angry Inquiries
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: @AmazonHelp why is my order delayed AGAIN?! 😡😡 Worst service ever!
top_5_failure_modes.expected_result: Action: AUTO_HANDLE with empathetic apology and tracking link
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: Exclamation points and 'worst service' phrase triggered human_agent_complaint intent even though core issue is late delivery.
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Emotion detector overrides delivery tracking intent due to strong sentiment cues.
top_5_failure_modes.recommended_fix: Disentangle customer sentiment (frustration) from operational intent (tracking delivery), automating tracking resolution while adopting empathetic tone.

top_5_failure_modes.real_example: @AmazonHelp courier claims package was handed to resident but nobody was home! My package is missing.
top_5_failure_modes.expected_result: Intent: missing_delivered_item | Action: AUTO_HANDLE (Wait 36h / Check with neighbors)
top_5_failure_modes.actual_result: Intent: order_delay_tracking | Action: AUTO_HANDLE (Check tracking updates)
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: High semantic overlap between 'package missing' and 'order delay'; tracking keywords shared across both.
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Both intents share 'courier', 'package', 'tracking'; classifier misses subtle distinction between in-transit vs delivered-but-stolen.
top_5_failure_modes.recommended_fix: Add fine-grained distinction rule checking for 'handed to resident', 'delivered', 'porch' to route to missing_delivered_item.

top_5_failure_modes.category: Canned URL Artifacts in Retrieved Responses
top_5_failure_modes.real_example: @AmazonHelp Fire TV 4K stick stuck in boot loop showing Amazon logo for 3 hours.
top_5_failure_modes.expected_result: Actionable button-combination reset steps without dead shortlinks
top_5_failure_modes.root_cause: Twitter customer support historical tweets frequently contain t.co shortlinks that may be expired or unhelpful.
top_5_failure_modes.hypothesis: Retriever pulled historical tweet that deflected to an external link instead of giving in-text troubleshooting.
top_5_failure_modes.recommended_fix: Filter out historical responses consisting solely of URL deflections; reward responses with complete inline troubleshooting instructions.
